name: kanban.cards
description: Private beta Kanban board for human and agent-controlled cards.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:cli && npm run build:static
scripts.build:static: cp styles.css public/styles.css && cp robots.txt public/robots.txt
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && tsx scripts/check-ui-contract.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.demo:prepare: npm run build && tsx scripts/demo.ts prepare
scripts.demo:server: NODE_ENV=development VERCEL= KANBAN_CARDS_DATA_PATH=.demo/kanban-cards-state.json KANBAN_CARDS_DATABASE_URL= POSTGRES_URL= DATABASE_URL= KANBAN_CARDS_API_TOKEN= INSTRUCT_API_TOKEN= KANBAN_CARDS_BASIC_USER= KANBAN_CARDS_BASIC_PASSWORD= node dist/src/server.js
